mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM practice_record r INNER JOIN question_info q ON q.question_id = r.question_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON kp.knowledge_point_id = r.knowledge_point_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_record WHERE review_status = 0) AS pending_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_record WHERE review_status = 1) AS reviewed_count, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(review_score), 1), 0) FROM practice_record WHERE review_status = 1) AS review_avg_score, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(is_correct) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) FROM practice_record WHERE question_type < 4) AS objective_accuracy
